newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on renewed buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on renewed buying interest.

text.p: Dhaka stocks surged 5.69 percent higher at the close on Wednesday amid renewed buying by investors, brokers said.
Brokers said investors, who had resorted to panic selling over the regulator's warning against speculative trading and taking risk on losing companies, returned and made fresh commitments.

"The market is picking up after a brief slump. It is buoyant again," said one broker. The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share index rose 5.69 percent or 109.17 points to 2025.17 on a sharply higher turnover of 216.9 million taka. Of the 95 issues traded, 87 closed up, 7 ended down and one was unchanged.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co gained 28 taka to 317, Shinepukur Holdings rose 16 to 184 and Apex Foods rose 841 to 10,500.
